statement: One run of the Python suite on the Oct 11 Linux box, at the pushed head c4dbf0f, with the command CLAUDE.md names for a push. It is here because the count published from the other session's box does not reproduce on this one, and a count with no environment beside it is not a measurement.
command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest flashmap pipeline eval -q -m "not slow" -p no:cacheprovider
why_they_fail: Both are verify's PSNR comparisons against a still drawn over a hold. On this box's ffmpeg 6.1.1 the overlay loses the still part way through the interval (docs/STATUS.md section 5). The hosted python job on the same commit is green (CI run 38112814399) and the other session's run on ffmpeg 7.1.5 passed both.

correction.finding: why_they_fail above was wrong about the cause. Read frame by frame, the rendition showed the still to the last frame of the span. cover_psnr in pipeline/render.py asked ffmpeg for one frame and read the end-of-run average line, an average over however many frames ffmpeg compared before it stopped, which is a race that a busy box loses and an idle one wins.
correction.fixed_by: cover_psnr compares exactly one frame (trim=end_frame=1 on both inputs); verify's cover proof samples the first frame, the middle and the last frame of each covered span and records the ffmpeg that measured it; pipeline/tests/test_verify.py::TestTheCoverProofReachesTheEdgesOfASpan was seen to fail against the old proof; mutation cover-proof-reaches-the-end-of-a-span.
correction.after_the_fix: both tests pass on this box; see results/local_python_run_2026-10-11_fixed.json for the rerun once it finishes.
